Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Square Nesting End/Side Tables, Black Metal and Tempered Mirror Glass
Colors: Gray
Materials: Metal
These modern nesting tables make entertaining easy while delivering an elegant touch. Black metal frames and distressed mirror glass tops add to the sleek look. This set is compact when nested, and brings a handsome touch to a room when apart. Large: 20x16.14x21.26; Small 16.14x14.17x17.32 Metal and tempered glass Clean, sleek lines give a simple and handsome look Keep nestled next to a couch or separate for maximum functionality Simple assembly in 30 minutes or less; just screw on legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
